title: FrontDoorConfiguration
description: Applications a customer exposes through the platform Front Door in one environment. File location: configuration/<customer>/front-door/<environment>/front-door-config.yaml

customer.description: Customer number (op001, op002, …). Must equal the <customer> folder in the path.

environment.description: Target environment. Must equal the <environment> folder in the path. Lifecycles: rnd (rnd), npd (dev, tst), prd (ppd, prd).

name.description: Application name, unique within msdhn.com. Host name: <name>.msdhn.com in prd, <name>-<environment>.msdhn.com in rnd, dev, tst and ppd.

appService.description: Resource ID of the App Service (origin) in the customer's subscription for this environment.

enabled.description: false keeps the application deployed but turns its route off.

isFrontDoorManagedCertificate.description: true: Front Door issues and renews the certificate (DigiCert). false: the customer provides the certificate in its own Key Vault and the platform copies it to the central Key Vault.

keyVaultName.description: Customer Key Vault (in the customer's subscription for this environment) holding the certificate. Required when isFrontDoorManagedCertificate is false.

certificateName.description: Key Vault certificate object in keyVaultName. Use either certificateName or secretName when isFrontDoorManagedCertificate is false.

secretName.description: Key Vault secret in keyVaultName holding the certificate with its private key: PFX/PKCS#12, base64, without password (content type application/x-pkcs12), or PEM with key and full chain (content type application/x-pem-file). Use either certificateName or secretName when isFrontDoorManagedCertificate is false.

then.$comment: Exactly one source: a Key Vault certificate or a Key Vault secret.

else.$comment: keyVaultName, certificateName and secretName are only allowed with isFrontDoorManagedCertificate: false.
